topography.project_purpose: SquadSwap is a multi-chain decentralized exchange (DEX) protocol that enables users to swap tokens, provide liquidity, and earn yield through farming. It supports automated market-making (AMM) with concentrated liquidity (V3) and classic AMM (V2) pools, along with staking and yield optimization features.
topography.relationship_narrative: SquadSwap V3 and V2 families share common farming infrastructure (MasterChefV2/V3) and token descriptors, while SquadSwap Dynamo is a separate V2 instance with its own factory and token. All families operate independently but may share peripheral contracts like routers and multicall interfaces across deployments.
